title: Client Billing of Tests to Physician Client Accounts
content:
A test is client-billed to one of the Physician Client Accounts only when its order carries the client-bill billing method and names that client account.

## Guidance

1. **Order link.** A test is client-billed only when its order carries the client-bill billing method and this account's client account reference.
2. **Account status.** A test may be client-billed only while the account status, as the account record shows it, is active or credit hold. Orders placed while on credit hold are not accepted for client billing, but tests ordered before the hold are still billed.
3. **Payer of the patient.** Tests for a patient whose coverage on the date of service is Original Medicare Part B are never client-billed when the account class prohibits client billing of Original Medicare Part B patients, nor for a Medicaid Managed Care Plan patient when the class prohibits client billing of Medicaid patients; those orders are billed to the payer. Commercially insured patients' tests are client-billed only where the class allows client billing of commercially insured patients.
4. **Client price.** The client price of a test is its test-menu list price less the class's client fee schedule discount percent, rounded to the cent. Each client-billed test is one line on the account, per test per order, showing the list price, the client price charged and the client invoice month.
5. **Invoice period.** Lines fall into the calendar-month invoice period of their billing date; the client invoice is issued on the class's client invoice day of the next month.

## Account status and timing of the order

| Account status on record | When the test was ordered | Client billing |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Any time the account is active | May be client-billed |
| Credit hold | Before the hold began | Still billed |
| Credit hold | While the account is on credit hold | Not accepted for client billing |
| Pending setup | Any | Not client-billed |
| Closed | Any | Not client-billed |

## Patient's coverage on the date of service

| Coverage on the date of service | Class setting | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | Class prohibits client billing of these patients | Never client-billed; billed to the payer |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | Class prohibits client billing of Medicaid patients | Never client-billed; billed to the payer |
| Commercial plan | Class allows client billing of commercially insured patients | May be client-billed |
| Commercial plan | Class does not allow it | Not client-billed |

## Worked price (hypothetical inputs)

A test with a list price of USD 87.35 on an account whose class discount is taken here as 45 percent: the client price is the list price less 45 percent of it, that is 55 percent of USD 87.35, which is USD 48.0425, rounded to the cent USD 48.04. With a discount of 58 percent the client price is 42 percent of USD 87.35, USD 36.687, rounded to the cent USD 36.69.

## Worked invoice period (hypothetical dates)

A test billed on 18 March falls into the March invoice period, and appears on the client invoice issued on the class's invoice day in April. A test billed on 1 April falls into the April period, on the invoice issued in May.
